House rule: the risk half of Wild Magic Sorcery, available from level 1. Whenever you spend spell points on a spell of 1st level or higher, a surge may follow. Cantrips never trigger anything.

Ring onRing offRing drained
Surge rollOnce per turn, your choiceForced after every qualifying spellForced
ContainmentNever drops; recoversDrops by 1 per spellDrops, never recovers

Roll a d20. If the result is equal to or higher than your current Containment, roll on the Lilians Wild Magic (d100) table. The result also sets your visible season until your next Long Rest. A result of 97–00 (The Pact) leaves your appearance unchanged.

Containment starts at 20. With the ring off it drops by 1 for each qualifying spell, after that spell's roll. With the ring on it recovers 1 per round, up to 20. See Containment Ring.

Automated: the module watches your Spell Points item, rolls the d20 against your Containment, rolls the d100 table, posts the result, stores your season and switches your Visage appearance.
